Name: Nkishi

[EK:R]
Cardtype: Equipment
Unique equipment. Requires a Laibon.
You may use a master phase action to search your library or ash heap
for an Aye or an Orun and put that card on this Laibon.
Artist: Vince Locke

Consider the draft efect of DESPIRAL, for example.

If I have a Laibon with Nkishi, can i retreive a Despiral from my
library or ash heap and place it on this Laibon? Is that what the
draft text is supposed to allow when it states something like "it
counts as an Aye and an Orun, even when not in play"? (sorry i dont
have a card here to copy the draft text).

Thanks
Powerlord
Prince of Lisboa
Portugal
